the type III secretion system needles are thermally stabilized by carbohydrates and polyols and that the needles are adsorbed to aluminum hydroxides via a combination of hydrogen bonding and Van der Waals interactions.
the needle proteins MxiI, PrgI, and BsaL are immunogenic when formulated as a monomer or polymer and adsorbed onto aluminum salt adjuvants.
